input.free_text_description: This system is a microservices platform that serves Candidate, Admin roles. It manages core business objects including jwt user, jwt request, email, user role. The platform provides capabilities for global default exception handler, my web socket handler, chinese proverb server handler. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include user management functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a Candidate, I want to create and manage jwt user records, so that I can track and organize jwt user data effectively.
As a Candidate, I want to create and manage jwt request records, so that I can track and organize jwt request data effectively.
As a Candidate, I want to create and manage email records, so that I can track and organize email data effectively.
As a Candidate, I want to create and manage user role records, so that I can track and organize user role data effectively.
